# Messages

Every message that goes in or out of the pipeline. The protobuf files are the contract: the Java stubs (`java/contracts-java`), the Python stubs (`python/realy/*/v1/*_pb2.py`) and this page are generated from them. Fields are only ever appended (a number is never reused or renumbered; `tests/test_proto_compat.py` fails otherwise), so old readers and old data keep working.

## Topics

| Topic | Value | Key | Headers | Partitions | Produced by | Consumed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payments.events.raw` | `realy.payments.v1.TransactionEvent` | customer_id (decimal string) | `x-bench-trace`, `x-run-id`, `x-backfill`, `x-mirrored`, `x-event-type` | 48 | emitter (`emit/driver.py`, Java load-emitter), gateway mirror of sync decisions | Flink feature job (`FraudJob` source), gateway Kafka ingress (`KafkaIngress`), ClickHouse `events_raw` (Kafka engine) |
| `payments.events.assembled` | `realy.payments.v1.TransactionEvent` | customer_id (decimal string) | `x-bench-trace`, `x-run-id`, `x-txn`, `x-read-only` | 48 |  |  |
| `payments.decisions` | `realy.scoring.v1.DecisionRecord` | customer_id (decimal string) |  | 48 | gateway (`DecisionSink`), Flink inline job (`decisions-sink`) | collector (`collect/collector.py`), ClickHouse `decisions` (Kafka engine), console live feed |
| `payments.devices.telemetry` | `realy.devices.v1.DeviceTelemetry` | device_id (decimal string) | `x-event-type`, `x-run-id`, `x-backfill` | 24 |  |  |
| `payments.events.dlq` | `the original record's bytes, unchanged` | the original record's key | `x-dlq-error`, `x-dlq-service`, `x-dlq-source` | 6 |  |  |
| `payments.labels` | `realy.payments.v1.FraudLabel` | customer_id (decimal string) |  | 12 | emitter, at each label's simulated time (needs the `x-run-id` header) | ClickHouse `labels` (Kafka engine) for training and reports |
| `bench.control` | `realy.bench.v1.ControlMessage (proto3 JSON)` | <target> |  | 1 | runner (`common/control.py`), console control drawer (`/api/live/*`) | gateway, model server, Flink jobs, emitters (`<target>:<cmd>` keys; `*` = every service) |
| `bench.metrics` | `realy.bench.v1.MetricsSnapshot (proto3 JSON)` | <source>:<instance> |  | 6 | every service and process (1 s `MetricsSnapshot`: emitter, collector, gateway, model, flink) | runner (`metrics.jsonl`, guardrails), console telemetry hub (Live) |

Partition counts are the production defaults; the compose stack creates 12 per topic. Headers on `payments.events.raw`: `x-bench-trace` (a `BenchTrace`: run, intended and sent time, clock domain), `x-run-id` (the owning run; `:backfill` / `:prime` suffixes for history), `x-backfill` (history: Flink folds it into state, the gateway does not score it), `x-mirrored` (a sync decision already made, mirrored so Flink updates state).

### `IngressCommand`

Enable/disable a service's Kafka ingress (topology switching without restarts). On enable the consumer seeks to the end of the topic, so a new run never processes an old backlog.

| # | Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `kafka_enabled` | `bool` |  |
| 2 | `topic` | `string` | the topic the Kafka ingress consumes ("" = EVENTS_TOPIC, the raw events): a run with multi-message transactions scores the assembled ones (payments.events.assembled) |

The assembler's state of one open transaction (Flink keyed state, keyed by the partition entity; internal, versioned by its own fields).

| 2 | `payload` | `bytes` | the message as received |
